claim: Patchline ships reproducible package-registry distribution with signed, content-pinned releases. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the registry distribution claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make registry-distribution-gate`.
